name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The role that is assigned to the user. Valid values:

USER: a regular user.
DBA : a database administrator (DBA).
ADMIN: a Data Management (DMS) administrator.
SECURITY_ADMIN: a security administrator.
STRUCT_READ_ONLY: a schema read-only user.

To check your role, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console
parameters.help_zh:
用户角色，取值说明如下：

USER：普通用户
DBA：DBA
ADMIN：管理员
SECURITY_ADMIN：安全管理员
STRUCT_READ_ONLY：结构只读

您可在DMS控制台右上角头像处查看您的角色
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The status of the user. Valid values:

NORMAL: The user is normal.
DISABLE: The user is disabled.
DELETE: The user is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
用户状态，取值说明如下：
NORMAL：正常
DISABLE：禁用
DELETE：已删除
parameters.name: user_state

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

**

Valid values: 10, 20, 50, and 100.**** Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。
每页记录数，取值：10、20、50、100。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

CurExecuteCount.description_en: The number of queries that were performed on the current day

CurResultCount.description_en: The number of rows that were queried on the current day

DingRobot.description_en:
The DingTalk chatbot URL that is used to receive notifications.



The system returns this parameter if you have set a DingTalk chatbot URL in the console. To set a DingTalk chatbot URL in the console, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and click the Edit icon next to Notice.

The system does not return this parameter if you have not set a DingTalk chatbot URL
DingRobot.description_zh:
钉钉机器人，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过钉钉机器人，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过钉钉机器人，此处则没有返回

Email.description_en:
The email address that is used to receive notifications.



The system returns this parameter if you have set an email address in the console. To set an email address in the console, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and click the Edit icon next to Notice.

The system does not return this parameter if you have not set an email address
Email.description_zh:
电子邮箱，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过电子邮箱，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过电子邮箱，此处则没有返回

LastLoginTime.description_en: The time when the user last logged on to the console

MaxExecuteCount.description_en: The maximum number of queries that can be performed on the current day

MaxResultCount.description_en: The maximum number of rows that can be queried on the current day

Mobile.description_en:
The mobile phone number of the user.



The system returns this parameter if you have set a mobile phone number in the console. To set a mobile phone number in the console, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and click the Edit icon next to Notice.

The system does not return this parameter if you have not set a mobile phone number
Mobile.description_zh:
用户手机号码。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过手机号码，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过手机号码，此处则没有返回

NotificationMode.description_en:
The notification method. The system returns one or more values. Valid values:

SMS: text message
EMAIL: email.
DINGDING: DingTalk.
DINGROBOT: DingTalk chatbot.
WEBHOOK: webhook
NotificationMode.description_zh:
消息通知方式，返回值可能为多个值，单个返回值说明如下：
SMS：短信
EMAIL：电子邮箱
DINGDING：钉钉
DINGROBOT：钉钉机器人
WEBHOOK：Webhook

ParentUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the user

The ID of the role that is assigned to the user. Valid values:

1: a regular user role.
2: a DBA role.
3: a DMS administrator role.
4: a security administrator role.
6: a schema read-only user role

角色ID列表，具体角色ID的返回值说明如下：
1：表示角色为普通用户。
2：表示角色为DBA。
3：表示角色为管理员。

DBA : a DBA.

SECURITY_ADMIN: a security administrator.
STRUCT_READ_ONLY: a schema read-only user
items.description_zh:
角色名称列表，具体的角色名称返回值说明如下：
USER：普通用户
DBA：DBA
ADMIN：管理员
SECURITY_ADMIN：安全管理员

The signature method that is used to secure connections when a webhook URL is used. Valid values:

HMAC_SHA1: HMAC_SHA1

Webhook签名方式，返回值说明如下：
NONE：不签名
HMAC_SHA1：HMAC_SHA1

State.description_en:
The status of the user. Valid values:

NORMAL: The user is normal.
DISABLE: The user is disabled.
DELETE: The user is deleted
State.description_zh:
用户状态，返回值说明如下：
NORMAL：正常
DISABLE：禁用
DELETE：已删除

Uid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

Webhook.description_en:
The webhook URL that is used to receive notifications.



If you have set a webhook URL, DMS sends notifications to the specified URL.

The system does not return this parameter if you have not set a webhook URL
Webhook.description_zh:
Webhook，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经配置过Webhook，当DMS中有消息通知时，系统会将消息通知发送到您指定的URL地址。
如果您没有配置过，此处则没有返回
